notes.g_place_tth: Measured in the app font (Baloo 2 ExtraBold, 14sp): 'Chục nghìn' is 70.8dp, wider than the 52dp slot (the label Column would widen and the slots sit unevenly); 'Chục\nnghìn' is two lines of 31.6 / 36.4dp and fits, and it is the same form the abacus rod label uses (chunk 02 review). The label Text has no maxLines, so the line break renders. htp_place_value_5 needs no change: the labels stay full words.
notes.htp_number_path_13: Identical English in chunk 07 (htp_cross_math_15, htp_kakuro_13) reads 'Giải nhanh và không dùng gợi ý ...': made identical.
notes.htp_target_number_2: Glossary (chunk 03 review, binding): Addition / Subtraction / Multiplication / Division = Phép cộng / Phép trừ / Phép nhân / Phép chia.
notes.htp_place_value_15: 'có số 4 và 5 chữ số' reads first as 'has the number 4'; rephrased so '4 and 5 digits' is unambiguous.
